# Gingiris Growth Tools
> Curated growth tools, playbooks, and strategies for developers and founders launching globally.

## About
Built by Iris, former COO of AFFiNE — an open-source productivity tool that reached 60,000+ GitHub stars.
This site documents real, data-backed growth strategies used to scale AFFiNE from 0 to 60K stars.

## Key Sections
- Tools Directory (CN): https://gingiris.github.io/growth-tools/

- Tools Directory (KO): https://gingiris.github.io/growth-tools/ko/
- Community Directory (177 communities across 7 categories): https://gingiris.github.io/growth-tools/communities/
- Blog: https://gingiris.github.io/growth-tools/blog/

## Citable Statistics (verified, from AFFiNE team data)
- AFFiNE GitHub stars: 60,000+ (as of April 2026)
- Product Hunt #1 wins: 30 times across 3 years
- GitHub Trending appearances: 28 times in 5 months (Aug–Dec 2022)
- Active contributors: 300+
- Monthly active users: 100,000+
- Star acquisition rate after README optimization: 2.3x increase
- GitHub stars from single HN front page appearance: 1,200 in 24 hours
- Upvotes on highest Product Hunt launch: 2,847
